segments.tha-ap544:4.1: “Sa kadāci tilokaggo, veneyyaṃ vinayaṃ bahuṃ [veneyye viniyaṃ bahū (sī.)];
segments.tha-ap544:5.3: Vaṇṇayanto parisatiṃ, tosesi [toseti (syā. pī. ka.)] janataṃ jino.
segments.tha-ap544:7.3: ‘Mudito hohi tvaṃ brahme, lacchase taṃ manorathaṃ.
segments.tha-ap544:8.3: Gotamo nāma gottena, satthā loke bhavissati.
segments.tha-ap544:9.3: Revato nāma nāmena, hessati satthu sāvako’.
segments.tha-ap544:11.1: “Pacchime ca bhave dāni, jātohaṃ koliye pure;
segments.tha-ap544:13.1: “Kaṅkhā me bahulā āsi, kappākappe tahiṃ tahiṃ;
segments.tha-ap544:13.3: Sabbaṃ taṃ vinayī buddho, desetvā dhammamuttamaṃ.
segments.tha-ap544:14.3: Viharāmi tadā buddho, maṃ disvā etadabravi.
segments.tha-ap544:15.1: “‘Yā kāci kaṅkhā idha vā huraṃ vā, sakavediyā vā paravediyā vā;
segments.tha-ap544:15.3: Ye jhāyino tā pajahanti sabbā, ātāpino brahmacariyaṃ carantā’.
segments.tha-ap544:16.1: “Satasahasse kataṃ kammaṃ, phalaṃ dassesi me idha;
segments.tha-ap544:19.1: “Svāgataṃ vata me āsi … pe … kataṃ buddhassa sāsanaṃ.
segments.tha-ap544:21.1: Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā kaṅkhārevato thero imā gāthāyo Abhāsitthāti.

lines: Dutiyāpadāne padumuttaro nāma jinotiādikaṃ āyasmato kaṅkhārevatattherassa apadānaṃ.
Ayampi purimabuddhesu katādhikāro tattha tattha bhave vivaṭṭūpanissayāni puññāni upacinanto padumuttarassa bhagavato kāle brāhmaṇakule nibbatto, taṃ sabbaṃ pāṭhānusārena suviññeyyamevāti.
